mil3.2.4:1.2: Bhante Nāgasena, yo na paṭisandahati vedeti so kañci dukkhaṃ vedanan ti. -
mil3.2.4:1.6: Kāyikaṃ mahārāja vedanaṃ vedeti, cetasikaṃ vedanaṃ na vedetīti. -
mil3.2.4:1.7: Katham-bhante kāyikaṃ vedanaṃ vedeti, kathaṃ cetasikaṃ vedanaṃ na vedetīti.
mil3.2.4:1.8: Yo hetu yo paccayo kāyikāya dukkhavedanāya uppattiyā tassa hetussa tassa paccayassa anuparamā kāyikaṃ dukkhavedanaṃ vedeti, yo hetu yo paccayo cetasikāya dukkhavedanāya uppattiyā tassa hetussa tassa paccayassa uparamā cetasikaṃ dukkhavedanaṃ na vedeti.
mil3.2.4:1.10: So ekaṃ vedanaṃ vedeti: kāyikaṃ, na cetasikan-ti. -
mil3.2.4:2.1: Bhante Nāgasena, yo so dukkhavedanaṃ vedeti kasmā so na parinibbāyatīti. -
mil3.2.4:2.2: Na-tthi mahārāja arahato anunayo vā paṭigho vā, na ca arahanto apakkaṃ pātenti, paripākaṃ āgamenti paṇḍitā.
mil3.2.4:2.3: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja therena Sāriputtena Dhammasenāpatinā:
